stem: 书面表达：围绕「Then and now」，写一篇 5 句英文短文对比家乡或学校过去与现在的变化。提示词：years ago, there was/were, now, modern, love.

answer.reference: My school has changed a lot. Ten years ago, there was no gym or big library. Now, there is a bright gym and a modern library. We can read and play sports happily. I love my school.

solution:
写作指导：对比运用 There was/were 与 There is/are。
